# Lumilens Inc.

ActiveUpdated 3/25/2026 12:00:00 AM

Lumilens Inc., a Stock Corporation, is a business entity located in San Jose, CA. Officially filed on August 21, 2024, this corporation is recognized under the document number 6355759. Governed by the California Secretary of State, the corporation maintains an active filing status.

The principal address of the corporation is located at 2570 N 1st Street 300, San Jose, CA 95131 and mailing address is at 2570 N 1st St Suite 300, San Jose, CA 95131, serving as the central hub for its business operations and correspondence.

The corporation is led by a team of key individuals: Ankur Singla from San Jose CA, holding the position of Chairperson of Board; David Friedman from San Jose CA, serving as the Chief Executive Officer; David Friedman from San Jose CA, serving as the Chief Financial Officer; David Friedman from San Jose CA, serving as the Secretary.

Ensuring the legal and official compliance of the corporation, David Friedman acts as the registered agent. He operates from 2570 North First Street Suite 300, San Jose, CA 95131.
